title: Customer appreciation and concerns
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes broad appreciation for the G60’s overall quality and interior aesthetic with scattered concerns and requests about range, convenience features, and service handling, while many fragments are too vague to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car overall, call it solid and fantastic, and specifically appreciate the interior and overall aesthetic.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on very poor range in one case and a separate annoyance described without enough detail to identify the exact issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments include incomplete statements, expressions of appreciation or excitement without clear evaluative context, and concerns or feature requests about glass, access, remote functions, and automatic window closing that are not consistently labeled for sentiment here.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are generic or incomplete, which limits confident interpretation of the underlying issue or sentiment.
This topic clusters loosely related appreciation, concerns, service dissatisfaction, and feature requests rather than one single coherent product aspect.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether some undetermined fragments should be treated as positive or negative beyond their assigned labels.
